displayIdentity.body: A death sentence redirects trust toward God. For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, about our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life. you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.
displayIdentity.title: A death sentence redirects trust toward God
